notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 4th, 2025
notes.notes:
Hello to our wonderful Project Teddy fans!

Today we released a minor update, which upgrades our game engine (Godot) to the latest stable version (4.3). This update increases stability and performance.

Have fun gaming!

notes.title: Update Notes for June 3rd, 2024
notes.notes:
Hello Project Teddy fans! Today we have a new patch which brings some nice enhancements!

Rough breakdown of the new features:

[list]
[*] Nice looking new sky on all the maps taken from our current project Echoes of Alexi!
[*] A new map called Alexi Village, also taken from Echoes of Alexi.
[*] The bricks on Toy Factory are finally rotated the correct direction (again).
[*] Map selection is now a dropdown!
[*] A few internal improvements to the codebase.
[/list]

Have fun playing Project Teddy!

Moreflight Studios

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 4
notes.notes:
